meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织好画面轨道与子合成,让项目如期渲染
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做动画合成,想一次写对项目结构避免返工
copy.tagline_en: Organize tracks and sub-compositions to make your project render reliably
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're creating animated compositions and want to get the structure right without rework

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范写/改一个可渲染合成:用 data-* 控制时间、class="clip" 标片段、单一暂停时间线、确定性渲染;按 STORYBOARD/SCRIPT 写计划并 lint 校验。
howto.when: 当需要写/改 HyperFrames 合成 HTML,编排时间轴、片段、子合成、媒体,或写 STORYBOARD/SCRIPT 计划、处理 Tailwind 项目时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude authors or edits one renderable HyperFrames composition: data-* timing, class="clip", a single paused timeline, deterministic-render rules; supports sub-comps, variables, media; writes STORYBOARD.md/SCRIPT.md plans; runs lint checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to write/edit HyperFrames composition HTML, arrange timeline/clips/sub-compositions/media, produce STORYBOARD/SCRIPT plans, or handle Tailwind projects.

say_en.text: Create a minimal HyperFrames composition HTML.
Add a sub-composition with variables to this project.
say_en.note: Wires it per the sub-compositions spec.

say_en.text: Write a STORYBOARD.md plan for this project.
